|translation='''Title:''' Imperial Blaster.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 1 Force to deploy on a warrior character. Spend 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny exceeds ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny exceeds maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:'''
A BlasTech DH-17 blaster pistol. It uses energy packs and high-energy blaster gas and fires explosive focused light.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese wording describes firing the weapon where the original English says to target.
